thread:
Ada: Heads up — the token-econ sparkline for tenant `acme` shows big 5m spikes even tho daily burn is flat. looks like aggregation + delayed cache reconciliation. :eyes:
Ben: yup saw that this morning. is it only prefetch credits or all token attributions?
Camila: general problem. when the batcher reconciles credits later we end up attributing to later windows. creates transient double-counting in short windows.
Priya: can we debounce the sparkline and show 'raw' vs 'reconciled' modes? toggle or overlay with confidence band?
Ben: toggle works but compute-heavy. maybe show raw for 5m/1m, reconciled for >1h, and a tiny badge that says "reconciled lag: 8m"
Ethan: telemetry side: we can emit meta on each event: sampling_rate, reconciled_flag, reconciliation_batch_id. that lets the UI compute adjusted estimates and confidence intervals. requires router to tag requests with `route_hint` and `sampling_id`.
DevBot: deploy queued — branch `telemetry/annotate-sampling` @sha=abc123 (staging) :rocket:
Ada: UX: per-model card should surface "Effective token cost (cache-adjusted)" + hit-rate. sample mock: "$0.00012 (adj) — cache hit 72%"
Camila: implementation Q: where do we persist reconciled credits? current ledger has prefetch rows; we'd add `reconciliation_batch_id` and reconciled=true. query cost will change.
Ben: rollout bias: small canaries will show higher apparent cost because they miss warm cache. we need a normalization for rollout windows so PMs don't freak.
Priya: +1. expose `rollout_context` filter in dashboard and show a small note: "Canary window — expected higher token cost while warming". maybe hide small-sample anomalies automatically.
Ethan: sampling tradeoff: 10% sampling cuts telemetry spend but increases variance. propose adaptive sampling: bump to 50% for tenants with >20% variance or when hit-rate changes quickly.
Ada: Ops ask: add an alert if per-route effective token cost deviates >30% from 7d baseline. also surface sample_rate so alerts aren't noisy.
Camila: quick SQL sketch for reconciled burn (pseudo):
```
SELECT tenant, sum(CASE WHEN reconciled THEN adjusted_tokens ELSE estimated_tokens END) AS tokens,
       sum(cost) FROM token_ledger
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY tenant;
```
Ben: nice. Also want a "what-if" slider in console to preview savings if we route X% of traffic to cheaper variant B. show projected effective token cost and latency delta.
Priya: owners? I'll write the rollout copy and UX microcopy. Ada take the mock. Camila backend + ledger schema. Ethan router/telemetry. Ben wire to cost-export.
Ada: timeline: MVP internal in 2 sprints, public rollout 1 sprint after that.
Camila: small nit — need to ensure reconciliation job emits `last_reconciled_ts` so UI can label freshest point.
Ethan: will add `last_reconciled_ts` metric to the telemetry stream.
DevBot: deploy finished on staging — telemetry branch at sha=abc123 — run smoke tests? :white_check_mark:
Ben: I'll run smoke and hook up the internal cost-preview panel.
Ada: thanks all. follow-up sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
Priya: adding agenda: UX mock, sample-rate default, alert thresholds.
Camila: will paste schema diff in #eng-platform after lunch.
Ethan: FYI — router change will add ~0.5ms p99 to annotated requests; we measured in perf test. acceptable?
Ada: acceptable if it's opt-in per-route. we can gate via config.
Ben: ok. if anything else comes up paste it here. :shrug:
